title: Client Surface And Access Product Architecture
problem: Nako needs an accepted product architecture for Admin Web, Media Web, desktop playback, mobile clients, users, roles, Library Access, and permission-gated switching between media consumption and management.

evidence.summary: Opened a docs-first planning lane for Admin Web, Media Web, account/access staging, Management Context Links, desktop Tauri playback strategy, and mobile/native boundaries.

Completed by identity-and-library-access-contract: durable local users, roles, Library Access persistence, bootstrap administrator semantics, Admin API access management, and Public Client API effective-access enforcement.
Split media-web-client-foundation for local-media-first browser browsing/playback through Public Client API with route/API readiness as the first task.
Split admin-media-management-context-links for the current web product frontend to consume backend-computed Management Context Links without duplicating authorization in Media UI.

continue_policy.notes: Do not implement broad client/access work inside this planning lane. Identity/access, Media Web, and Management Context Links are split; split or defer desktop playback before closing this planning lane.
